title: AI Governance
description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

  

* We are looking for a Responsible AI RAI Compliance Lead to oversee the organization s compliance with AI governance and ethical standards
* The RAI Compliance Lead will play a crucial role in developing implementing and managing AI compliance frameworks to ensure that our AI systems meet regulatory ethical and transparency requirements
* This role involves working closely with various internal teams including legal data science AI development and external regulatory bodies to ensure that the organization s AI practices align with global standards and regulations

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

  

* Develop refine and lead the implementation of the organization s Responsible AI RAI compliance program aligning it with regulatory requirements and ethical best practices
* Design and implement governance frameworks that ensure ethical AI development deployment and monitoring
* Collaborate with legal and regulatory teams to ensure compliance with global AI regulations e
* g
* EU AI Act GDPR CCPA and internal governance policies
* Lead risk assessments to identify ethical legal and operational risks in AI systems with a focus on fairness transparency accountability and bias mitigation
* Create AI risk mitigation strategies in collaboration with technical teams to address identified risks and ensure ethical outcomes in AI driven decision making processes
* Develop AI auditing protocols and perform regular audits of AI models and systems to ensure they comply with organizational and regulatory standards
* Monitor and stay informed on emerging AI regulations industry standards and ethical guidelines to ensure compliance with AI governance frameworks
* Advise on the creation and refinement of internal policies guidelines and practices regarding the ethical use of AI technologies
* Regularly review and update compliance frameworks to meet evolving regulatory requirements
* Ensure thorough documentation of AI systems audits and compliance efforts to support both internal reviews and external reporting requirements
* Prepare regular reports for senior management on the status of AI compliance risk assessments and corrective actions
* Serve as the primary point of contact for audits or inquiries related to AI compliance from regulators or external assessors
* Lead internal training and awareness programs focused on AI compliance ethical AI practices and emerging regulations for relevant stakeholders
* Collaborate with HR legal and technical teams to ensure all employees involved in AI development and deployment understand their role in ensuring responsible and compliant AI use
* Provide ongoing support and resources for cross functional teams to ensure the consistent application of AI compliance protocols

  

**Technical Requirements:**
---------------------------

  

* Technical knowledge and expertise on AI ML Data Science and software development methodologies
* Structured problem solving and consulting skill sets
* Program management of large projects involving multiple stakeholders

  

**Additional Responsibilities:**
--------------------------------

  

* Soft Skills
* Good verbal written communication skills articulate value to delivery leads project managers other unit heads and negotiate and resolve conflicts

title: Gen Ai & Agentic Ai Trainer
description:
Generative AI & Agentic AI Technical Trainer

**Company:** Career Ladder  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 0–2 Years  
**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month  
**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

Job Overview

Career Ladder is looking for a passionate and technically skilled Generative AI & Agentic AI Technical Trainer with hands-on knowledge of Data Science, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, LLMs, RAG, and Agentic AI frameworks.

The candidate should be capable of delivering technical sessions, developing practical demonstrations, and mentoring students through real-world AI projects. Freshers with strong technical skills and project experience are welcome.

Key Responsibilities

* Deliver training sessions on Data Science, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI.
* Explain LLM architecture, parameters, Prompt Engineering, and API integration.
* Develop RAG applications using document processing, embeddings, retrieval, and vector databases.
* Build AI applications using LangChain, LangGraph, and CrewAI.
* Design multi-agent workflows and implement MCP-based integrations.
* Guide students through hands-on projects and real-world applications.
* Prepare technical materials, assignments, and project documentation.

Required Technical Skills

* **Data Science:** Python, Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and SQL.
* **Machine Learning:** ML algorithms, supervised and unsupervised learning, and model evaluation.
* **Deep Learning:** Neural networks, activation functions, training fundamentals, and optimization.
* **Generative AI:** LLMs, tokens, parameters, context windows, Prompt Engineering, and LLM API integration (OpenAI, Gemini, Groq, etc.).
* **RAG:** Document loaders, chunking, embeddings, semantic search, retrieval strategies, and vector databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Pinecone).
* **Agentic AI:** LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, MCP, tool calling, agent workflows, and multi-agent systems.
* **Programming & API Integration:** Python programming, Fast APIs, JSON, API authentication, and Git.

Eligibility Criteria

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, AI & ML, Data Science, or a related field.
* 0–2 years of relevant experience.
* Freshers with practical AI/ML or Generative AI project experience can apply.
* Good communication, presentation, and mentoring skills.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

* Hands-on experience building RAG applications, AI chatbots, or AI agents.
* Experience with LangGraph, CrewAI, and MCP integrations.
* GitHub portfolio or academic/personal AI projects.
* Previous teaching or mentoring experience is an added advantage.

Compensation & Benefits

* Salary: ₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month (based on skills and technical expertise).
* Opportunity to work on real-world AI projects.
* Exposure to emerging Generative AI and Agentic AI technologies.
* Career growth in AI development and technical training.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through Indeed with their updated resume. GitHub profiles and AI/ML project portfolios are encouraged.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:

Job Description

**AI Forward Deployed Engineer**

**Overview of Role:**

The AI Forward Deployed Engineer partners directly with business stakeholders to identify high-value opportunities and convert them into secure, scalable and measurable AI solutions. The role combines strong software engineering, generative AI and machine learning capability with stakeholder-facing delivery. It owns the journey from discovery and rapid prototyping through enterprise integration, production deployment, adoption and continuous improvement.

**KPIs:**

* **Business Impact:** Measured value delivered through AI solutions, including efficiency, quality, revenue, cost or risk outcomes.

* **Time to Production:** Speed and predictability in progressing priority use cases from discovery and proof of concept to production.

* **Solution Quality and Reliability:** Accuracy, relevance, latency, availability, scalability and operational stability of deployed solutions.

* **Adoption and Stakeholder Satisfaction:** Active usage, stakeholder feedback and successful integration into business workflows.

* **Security and Governance:** Adherence to data privacy, access control, responsible AI and enterprise governance requirements.

* **Reusability and Enablement:** Reusable accelerators, reference implementations, documentation and knowledge transfer created for broader adoption.

**Key Year One Deliverables:**

* **Opportunity and Current-State Assessment:** Assess priority business opportunities, existing AI capabilities, data sources, platforms, integrations and delivery constraints.

* **Stakeholder Needs Analysis:** Define business objectives, user needs, success measures, adoption barriers and technical requirements with key stakeholders.

* **Prioritized Delivery Roadmap:** Create and maintain a roadmap based on business value, feasibility, data readiness, risk and resource needs.

* **Prototypes and Proofs of Concept:** Develop rapid prototypes to validate technical feasibility, user value and solution direction.

* **Production AI Solutions:** Build, deploy and operationalize selected AI solutions with appropriate security, scalability, reliability and support readiness.

* **Enterprise Integration:** Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise applications, identity systems, APIs, data sources and operational workflows.

* **Evaluation and Observability:** Establish evaluation, error-analysis, logging, metrics, tracing, usage and cost-monitoring mechanisms.

* **Documentation and Enablement:** Deliver architecture documentation, runbooks, reusable patterns, training and knowledge transfer for users and support teams.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

* Hands-on experience developing software, machine learning or generative AI solutions through internships, academic projects or professional environments; production deployment experience is preferred.

* Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Experience and Skills:**

* **Software Engineering:** Strong Python programming; backend and API development using FastAPI, Flask REST or equivalent; REST APIs, SQL, relational databases, Git, testing, debugging and code review.

* **Generative AI and Context Engineering:** Large language models, prompt and context engineering, RAG and Graph RAG, embeddings, semantic search, vector databases, tool/function calling, memory, agent orchestration and evaluation.

* **Machine Learning:** ML and deep-learning fundamentals, natural language processing, model evaluation, data preprocessing and experience with PyTorch and/or TensorFlow.

* **Production Engineering:** Containerization, CI/CD, cloud or on-premises deployment, observability, performance tuning, scalability, resilience and production troubleshooting. Familiarity with multi-model architectures, AI gateways, model routing, token and cost management, and model selection is preferred.

* **Data and Integration:** Data pipelines, enterprise application integration, identity and access management, secure configuration and interoperability across systems.

* **AI Quality and Governance:** Evaluation frameworks, error analysis, guardrails, responsible AI, data privacy, security, access control, lifecycle management and usage/cost monitoring.

* **Forward Deployed Delivery:** Stakeholder discovery, problem decomposition, rapid prototyping, ambiguity management, end-to-end ownership, documentation and knowledge transfer.

* **Good to Have:** Microsoft Azure and Azure OpenAI; LangGraph, LangChain or comparable frameworks; Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector or FAISS; Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL and Redis; OpenTelemetry, Prometheus and Grafana; LiteLLM or comparable AI gateways.

**Key Behaviors:**

* **Customer and Business Focus:** Builds trusted stakeholder relationships and keeps solutions anchored to measurable user and business outcomes.

* **Ownership:** Takes responsibility from discovery through production stabilization, adoption and continuous improvement.

* **Problem Solving:** Uses structured analysis and hands-on troubleshooting across application, model, data, integration and infrastructure layers.

* **Agility and Adaptability:** Works effectively with ambiguity, changing priorities and evolving AI technologies.

* **Collaboration and Communication:** Explains complex topics clearly and works effectively across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security and business teams.

* **Continuous Learning:** Actively evaluates new approaches while applying sound engineering judgment, governance and evidence-based decision-making.

* **Attention to Detail:** Maintains high standards for quality, security, documentation and operational readiness.

**Reporting Structure:**

This role reports to the Innovation department lead.

**Visteon Culture**

If you thrive in a fast-paced organizational culture that requires agility, adaptability and a growth mindset to stay ahead of the curve, Visteon is the place. We value high performance and a drive for results. Innovation, risk-taking and continuous learning help us keep pace with the ever-changing landscape of our industry and remain market leaders. At Visteon, you can be more.

title: Data Science Trainer

**Job Type:** Full-Time / Part-Time  
**Department:** Training & Academics  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years (Preferred)

About the Role

We are looking for a skilled and passionate **Data Science Trainer** to deliver industry-oriented training in Data Science, Python programming, statistical analysis, machine learning, and data visualization. The ideal candidate should have strong technical expertise, practical project experience, and the ability to simplify complex concepts for students and aspiring professionals.

* Deliver practical and theoretical training in Data Science and related technologies.
* Teach Python programming, NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn, and data analysis techniques.
* Explain statistics, probability, exploratory data analysis (EDA), and data preprocessing.
* Train students in machine learning algorithms, model evaluation, and feature engineering.
* Introduce data visualization tools such as Power BI and Tableau.
* Guide students through real-world projects, case studies, assignments, and capstone projects.
* Develop course materials, presentations, lab exercises, assessments, and project documentation.
* Evaluate student performance and provide constructive feedback.
* Mentor students on portfolio development, resume preparation, and technical interview readiness.
* Stay updated with industry trends, emerging AI technologies, and current Data Science practices.
* Support academic activities, student progress tracking, and placement preparation.

Required Technical Skills

* Strong proficiency in Python programming.
* Knowledge of NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, and Seaborn.
* Understanding of statistics, probability, and exploratory data analysis.
* Practical knowledge of machine learning algorithms and model evaluation.
* Experience with SQL and relational databases.
* Knowledge of data cleaning, preprocessing, feature engineering, and visualization.
* Familiarity with Jupyter Notebook, Google Colab, and Git/GitHub.
* Basic understanding of Generative AI and AI-assisted data workflows is an advantage.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 1–3 years of experience in Data Science, Analytics, Machine Learning, or technical training.
* Candidates with relevant industry experience and a strong project portfolio are encouraged to apply.
* Prior teaching or mentoring experience is an added advantage.

Essential Soft Skills

* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts to beginners.
* Effective classroom management and student engagement.
* Problem-solving and analytical thinking.
* Passion for teaching, mentoring, and continuous learning.

Performance Expectations

* Deliver structured, practical, and industry-relevant training sessions.
* Ensure students complete hands-on exercises and real-world projects.

* Opportunity to work in a growing design and technology education environment.
* A collaborative team and practical teaching environment.
* Opportunities to contribute to curriculum development and student projects.
* Professional growth through exposure to emerging technologies.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated resume, relevant project portfolio, and details of their teaching or industry experience.
